title: AcDs schema-type advisory and current peer-source audit
mode: Primary-source web review and local source/test crosswalk; research-only
scope: Reconcile CVE-2026-111167 with ODA's AcDs schema property type domain.
Inspect the corresponding current mutable LibreDWG schema decoder path.
Verify that the local range-test recommendation from 2026-10-19 is implemented and define safe optional-peer use.

sources.name: CVE-2026-111167
sources.revision: CVE record published 2026-10-15; assigned by VulnCheck.
sources.observed: Reports an out-of-bounds read in LibreDWG acds_private() through 0.14.8612 when an oversized schdat schema property type indexes beyond a static type-size table.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Third-party security report; not a maintainer-confirmed patch status, local defect, or reproduced exploit in this review.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sources.observed: Defines normal property types 0 through 15; type 0xE carries a custom-size field, and fixed-size lookup uses a 16-entry table.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Normative byte-layout reference for the stated field domain; does not validate peer behavior or establish semantic interpretation of unknown schema payloads.

sources.name: LibreDWG current mutable acds.spec
sources.revision: Mutable master page reviewed 2026-10-20; no peer commit was built or executed.
sources.observed: The reviewed schdat decoder parses prop.type and directly indexes _AcDs_Schema_Prop_types[prop.type] for non-custom values; no range guard appears in that stanza.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source-shape correspondence only. Mutable source is not an immutable artifact or runtime exploitability result.

sources.name: Local implementation and regression owner
sources.revision: Shared worktree source/test inventory reviewed 2026-10-20; focused implementation receipt dated 2026-10-19.
sources.observed: The local parser checks the parsed type against SCHEMA_PROPERTY_TYPE_COUNT before table lookup. The generated profile tests legal 15 and invalid 16/UINT32_MAX, requiring an invalid-type diagnostic, invalid/non-replayable status, and bounded later-schema handling. The recorded graph-preservation CTest passed.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Local bounds regression evidence only; not an AcDs ownership, SAB, B-rep, or native-consumer qualification.

assessment.planImpact: Mark the local AcDs type-index test recommendation complete and require exact artifact/source guard inspection before optional peer parsing; keep malformed AcDs negative vectors local unless the peer build is verified fixed and isolated.

method.kind: Read-only web research plus local source/test/plan inspection
